name: workplace_it_support
description: A small synthetic knowledge base for reproducible retrieval evaluation.

chunks.text: Employees who forget passwords can request a reset link from the sign-in page. The link expires after fifteen minutes and can only be used once.
Multi-factor authentication protects each account by requiring a temporary code after the password. Employees can generate codes with an approved authenticator application on their phone.
Remote employees must connect through the company VPN before accessing internal tools. The online help desk provides installation instructions for Windows, macOS, and Linux devices.
New laptops are shipped within three business days after manager approval. Employees receive a tracking email when the equipment leaves the distribution center for delivery.
Damaged equipment should be reported to IT support immediately. The employee receives a prepaid return label and must send the device within ten days back.
When an employee leaves the company, access is disabled at the end of their final workday. Company devices must be returned before the departure date.
Employees can download a copy of their personal profile data from account settings. Export requests are prepared as encrypted files within twenty-four hours for download.
Security incidents such as suspicious emails or unexpected login prompts must be reported through the incident portal. Urgent reports are reviewed by on-call analysts immediately.
